description: Renovate settings shared across kanso-labs, extended as local>kanso-labs/.github by the runner's config.js and by every repository that ships a config of its own. It is listed after config:recommended so these values win, and it deliberately extends nothing itself: a preset that pulled in config:recommended would reinstate it for a consumer that had chosen otherwise. dependencyDashboard is off because nothing in this organization holds an update back — prConcurrentLimit and prHourlyLimit are 0 and recreateWhen is always everywhere — so every pending update is already an open pull request and the dashboard would do nothing but restate them.
